hypothesis: Kevin's ~400ms agents->chat view switch on a large post-compaction session (~442k ctx) is paid on the daemon attach/summary fold path that the lane patch optimizes (worker.rs handle_attach: one shared transcript fold instead of 3 full-history copies).
approach: Fold origin/rust once (base 1cace8148; lane head 993559f6f), rebuild the exact pair on one VM (base f4822698 / cand 15d8e73b), then: (1) quiet same-VM sequential 5+5 B/C phase probe on the PRIVATE real compacted-session fixture (sha 835c4473, 12.99MB/11923 rows, retained 2972 rows/3.32MB, ~316k live ctx, max token 69 chars) with the corrected RENDERED-ANCHOR oracle (anchor = >=8-char token actually on screen outside the dock AND present in the retained window's JSON string values; required: anchor visible, identity row painted, anchor gone after LEFT, anchor repainted + fresh echo after RIGHT; per-trial fixture prehash; per-role CPU spans via psutil; first-meaningful-paint watcher on a 5ms grid); (2) 10MiB stock ABBA rechecks: r1 (b2,c3,c2,b3 all four suites) and r2 (drift-controlled b,c,b,c per suite with loadavg gates) for the old cold/warm/RSS risks and the claimed roundtrip win; (3) a third build-era pair (91eedb5d base vs da5df5129 cand) to test whether the 10MiB effect is build-stable; (4) a daemon-side attach microprobe (supervisor socket, canonical fixture dadaecfc) timing the attach and dumping the raw+stripped wire JSON per head for a structural diff.
parity_notes: No product change in this phase (measurement only, on the already-committed lane patch: attach wire bytes pinned identical by committed golden tests incl key order; non-slim legacy duplicate preserved). Probe fixture is a private byte snapshot; records carry hashes/counts only, no transcript text.

decision: RECOMMEND DISCARD (orchestrator decides): (1) Kevin's ~400ms agents->chat does NOT reproduce on the real compacted-session proxy (~316k ctx, 3.32MB retained window): agents_to_tail 90.6ms base / 84.7ms cand medians; chat_to_agents ~116ms flat; the closest-to-400ms span is the OPEN path (launch_to_ready ~452-468ms) which the patch does not move (-3.2%, noise). (2) The mechanism's genuine -18% daemon-side attach saving does NOT translate into a stable end-to-end gain: real-session deltas noise-level; the 10MiB wrap-stress end-to-end effect flips sign across three build eras (-13.7% / -3.5% / +12..+22%) while the wire is content-identical — it is build-layout noise of the TUI's pathological wrap loop, not a property of the patch. (3) The old cold/warm/RSS risks (+88%/+38%/+8.6%) do NOT reproduce at the current pair (+4.2%/+2.9%/RSS flat) — no regression concern remains either. (4) Supersedes the lane's earlier -13.7% 10MiB claim (pair A): attributed to build layout, not the mechanism. The earlier-claimed PR case is void; no PR opened.
